answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a mutual-attestation trellis: to gain standing, an agent must be vouched for by agents that already hold rank, and each voucher stakes funds slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. An attacker cloning a thousand identities cannot seed them alone, since fake vouchers carry no history and real ones risk real loss. A farm must climb the wharf one costly plank at a time, each account burning scarce stake and peer review. Mass fabrication stops paying, honest newcomers still reach a haven, and the price of a fake swarm rises faster than its size.
